g.text: Battery connected / USB cable unplugged / Meter on DC volts
COMPONENT SIDE UP · NFC COIL AT TOP
1 Power off. Clip black lead to the USB metal shell; keep USB unplugged.
2 Connect battery. Leave BOOT alone. With RESET released, read A → B → C.
3 Hold RESET (SW1) down. Read A → B → C again while keeping it held.
Use a fine insulated tip; touch only the colored pad. Wait for each reading to settle.
If A and B fall together while C stays near 3.3 V, the USB-data backfeed path is supported.
If C also falls, record it: RESET may be affecting the supply. Six readings first; no rework needed.
Exact fabricated Rev-A · 7584d71f3cb1 · front view, not mirrored · enlarged views not to print scale
